market.intro: Oaxaca's hotel scene is accelerating. Live market research surfaced these recent openings:

competitors.name: Kymaia
competitors.detail: 22 suites, pre-Hispanic pyramid design, regenerative gardens. By the Casona Sforza founder.

competitors.name: Casa Yatí
competitors.detail: 8 rooms, oceanfront Ventanilla, Padre Studio design. Opened mid-2025.

competitors.name: Xiqué Boutique Hotel
competitors.detail: 8 rooms, Puerto Escondido, pink chukum + clay tiles. Estudio Carroll.

competitors.name: Hotel Humano
competitors.detail: 39 rooms, La Punta Zicatela, Grupo Habita portfolio. Surfer-shack aesthetic.

facts.text: Kymaia opened on the Oaxacan coast with 22 suites and regenerative gardens.
Casa Yatí opened mid-2025 in Ventanilla with 8 oceanfront rooms designed by Padre Studio.
Grupo Habita added Hotel Humano (39 rooms) to its La Punta Zicatela portfolio.
